svg.title: Three priority lanes feeding one push provider quota of 10,000 a second
svg.desc: Critical, transactional and bulk queues each have their own workers. The provider quota of 10,000 messages a second is split: bulk may use at most 8,000 a second, and 2,000 a second is held back for critical and transactional sends. With 49 million bulk messages waiting, an OTP waits only behind other OTPs.
svg.text: three lanes, one provider quota: bulk can never take all of it
one shared FIFO: an OTP behind 49 million pushes waits 49,000,000 ÷ 10,000 ≈ 82 min
lanes + a held-back share: it waits only behind other critical sends
